Corrections to pillar A checks first published in check set v1, found by the guard added alongside the v1.3 redirect fix rather than by a domain hitting them.

A.caa_present: `parse_caa` sets `present` from whether any issue, issuewild or iodef tag parsed, and the collector builds that dict whenever the CAA lookup is answered. A domain publishing only malformed or unrecognised CAA records therefore produces `observed` with `present: false` -- records exist, none of them mean anything to us -- and the rules tested only `present: true` and a `status: absent` the normalizer cannot produce in that case. Narrow, and reachable.

A.nameserver_diversity: a conclusive NS lookup returning no records at all matched neither `distinct_parent_count >= 2` nor `nameserver_count >= 1`. Diversity across zero nameservers is not a question with an answer, so this reports `unknown` and says why, rather than falling through to the same word with no explanation.

checks.rationale_ro: CAA limitează autoritățile de certificare care pot emite certificate pentru domeniu.
checks.rationale_en: CAA limits which certificate authorities may issue certificates for the domain.

checks.title_ro: Delegarea DNS folosește mai mulți furnizori
checks.title_en: DNS delegation uses more than one provider
checks.rationale_ro: Serverele de nume aflate toate la un singur furnizor concentrează riscul de indisponibilitate. Aceasta este o observație de reziliență, nu o vulnerabilitate.
checks.rationale_en: Nameservers all under a single provider concentrate availability risk. This is a resilience observation, not a vulnerability.
